saved mask comes from cell C5, which loads 1991-12-26 to 2004-09-05 (the time axis is complete and daily) and builds per-cell Hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day index windows around the baseline dates. It smooths them with a wrapped 31-day mean, so target day-of-year values 153–244 draw on raw days 138–259, which span 12 May to 20 Sep in each baseline year. Every target day (Jun–Aug 2004) of every sea cell is compared against these thresholds, and the result is run-detected and written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
